{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Who Is Mike Jones?; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for heavy guitar music right now, and this hip-hop album does not fit that mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: An Ocean Between Us; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic metalcore sound fits my interest in heavy riffs and melodic hooks; I would try it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash-oriented sound appeals to me, but I would choose Ascendancy first this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Stabbing the Drama; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I have interacted with several Soilwork albums, so this is a strong choice for more of that melodic heaviness.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ghost Reveries; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Tool and heavier metal makes its progressive arrangements and heavy passages appealing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Divine Wings of Tragedy; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The progressive metal direction interests me, but I would save it for another session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: American Psycho; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Horror punk is less aligned with the melodic and progressive metal I want right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rosenrot       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy industrial riffs appeal to me, but other albums here connect more closely with my recent listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fever; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough to choose it over the albums I recognize.
